trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum lands automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned, so treat it as the finish line of the whole roadmap rather than a task of its own. Work the stages in order, clear the missable watch list early, and leave the long counters for the cleanup stage. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official list; the order is this guide's own plan from the official descriptions.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies.
Check the Roadmap tab: all five stages at 100% means the platinum is yours.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and the trophy pops at the mission's end. It is the first story beat, so nothing can be missed before it. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the mission name; the rest follows from the official description.
steps: Play Gone Fishing to its end.
Follow the on-screen objectives; the trophy unlocks with mission completion.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through every mission of Chapter 1 until the chapter closes. Story chapters unlock in order, so this is a matter of finishing the chapter's missions, not of finding anything hidden. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the chapter requirement.
steps: Finish all Chapter 1 missions.
The trophy unlocks when the chapter ends.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 the same way as Chapter 1: finish its missions in order until the chapter closes. Nothing in the official description names a side task, so keep the story moving. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles.
steps: Finish all Chapter 2 missions.
The trophy unlocks when the chapter ends.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3's missions in order. By this point the map is opening up, but the trophy itself only asks for the chapter, so do not let side activities stall the story if you want it early. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles.
steps: Finish all Chapter 3 missions.
The trophy unlocks when the chapter ends.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 to close the last numbered chapter. The final mission trophy follows after this, so treat Chapter 4 as the run-up to the ending rather than the end itself. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles.
steps: Finish all Chapter 4 missions.
The trophy unlocks when the chapter ends.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the game's final mission and this gold trophy is yours. It is the story's last beat, so it can only be earned after Chapter 4, and it is the natural moment to start the post-story cleanup. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement and grade.
steps: Complete Chapter 4.
Play the final mission to its end.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Named story missions unlock as the story progresses, so this one arrives on its own if you keep playing the main path. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the mission name.
steps: Reach Breakfast Run in the story.
Complete the mission.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are story beats, so the trophy follows from playing the main path rather than from any preparation. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the mission name.
steps: Reach The Cartel Heist in the story.
Complete the mission.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Like the other named-mission trophies, it unlocks by finishing that mission, whenever the story takes you there. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the mission name.
steps: Reach Child's Play in the story.
Complete the mission.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. The mission name is the whole requirement, so there is no side task to prepare; just play the story until it appears. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the mission name.
steps: Reach Headliners in the story.
Complete the mission.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set at Vice City International Airport. The airport also matters for the Catch Me If You Can watch item, so keep that in mind while you are there. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the mission name.
steps: Reach VCIA Takedown in the story.
Complete the mission.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It is one of the last named missions before the finale, so it arrives late in the story; the trophy pops on completion. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the mission name.
steps: Reach Operation Savage Glory in the story.
Complete the mission.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion, which PSN tracks as a counter to 100. This is the long grind behind the platinum: story, stranger strands, collectibles and activities all feed the percentage, so it is best chased last, when the remaining pieces are the only ones left. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement and the 100 target.
steps: Finish the story and the stranger strands.
Clear collectibles and activities until the in-game completion stat reads 100%.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts, tracked by PSN as a counter to 250. Stunts build up naturally across normal driving, so the efficient play is to attempt them whenever you are travelling anyway and to leave the last stretch for a dedicated cleanup run. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the 250 target.
steps: Attempt jumps, near misses and airtime while driving.
Use the counter in this guide to track progress toward 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once; PSN tracks the count to 9. This is a sampler trophy: one go at each activity is enough, so it is cheap to clear early and it teaches you which activities you enjoy for the longer grinds. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the 9 target.
steps: Try one activity of each type.
Tick each type off in the counter until you reach 9.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, the PSN-tracked total. Gold means beating each challenge's gold threshold, so expect to replay the harder ranges and to learn their scoring before chasing gold everywhere. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the 42 target.
steps: Open each Shooting Range challenge and learn its gold threshold.
Replay challenges until all 42 show gold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location is a separate win, so the trophy is a tour of the drone-race map rather than one hard race; learn each course's corners and take them one at a time. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the 14 target.
steps: Find a Top Fun drone race location.
Win at each of the 14 locations.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Different is the key word: repeating the same race does not count, so work through the race list and keep a note of which ones you have already won. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the 20 target.
steps: Enter races you have not won yet.
Win 20 different ones.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head, so the win comes from out-fishing Cal in that challenge rather than from catching the biggest fish in free play. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement; the exact challenge rules are not yet confirmed in-game.
steps: Find Cal's fishing challenge.
Out-fish Cal to win it.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game, any of them. Pick the arcade game you find easiest and finish a full run; a single completion is all the trophy asks. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles.
steps: Visit an arcade.
Complete one arcade game.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Character mission strands end with a final mission each, so follow Andy's strand through its missions until its last one. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement.
steps: Play Andy's missions in order.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton by following his mission strand to its end. Kenton's strand is one of five character strands, each with its own final-mission trophy. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles.
steps: Play Kenton's missions in order.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy by following his mission strand to its end. The five character-strand finales are independent of the main chapters, so clear them as they appear. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles.
steps: Play Billy's missions in order.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida, tracked by PSN to 8. Stranger strands are the open-world side missions marked by their own characters; finish a whole strand, not just its first mission, for it to count. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the 8 target.
steps: Find stranger missions across Leonida.
Complete 8 full strands.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy by following his mission strand to its end. Randy's finale is one of the five character-strand trophies; the strand itself is the only requirement. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles.
steps: Play Randy's missions in order.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone by following his mission strand to its end. With all five character finales done, the story side of the list is nearly complete. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles.
steps: Play Tyrone's missions in order.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. The spots are spread over the whole state, so this is a slow tour best combined with exploring for The Goodtime State; tick each spot off as you find it. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the 18 target.
steps: Find a meditation spot and meditate there.
Repeat at all 18 spots.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. The animal is unique, so this is a specific hunt rather than general hunting; follow Bret's lead and take the animal he names. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement; the animal's location is not yet confirmed in-game.
steps: Take Bret's hunt.
Track and hunt the unique animal.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets, tracked by PSN to 3. Cards are a collectible hunt across Leonida; a set only counts when it is complete, so focus on finishing sets rather than scattering single cards. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the 3 target.
steps: Collect cards across Leonida.
Complete 3 full sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations, tracked by PSN to 100. This is the longest location grind on the list, so fold it into every trip: WAiNK at each new place you visit instead of saving it for a final sweep. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the 100 target.
steps: WAiNK It at each new location you visit.
Track progress toward 100 in the counter.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges, tracked by PSN to 50. Challenges span many activity types, so this fills in as you play everything else; check the challenge list late in the game and mop up the cheapest remaining ones. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the 50 target.
steps: Complete challenges across activities.
Mop up the easiest remaining ones until you reach 50.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. This is a watch item: the description names a specific co-op moment, a 4-star escape with your partner beside you, so set it up deliberately rather than hoping it happens by accident. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement.
trophies.missableBasis: From the official description: lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner — a specific co-op moment that may not repeat.
steps: Build a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner.
Lose the heat together and escape.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. This is a watch item: the chain breaks if the Wanted Level drops between shops, so plan a route of three close shops and move fast. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement.
trophies.missableBasis: From the official description: rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level — a chained co-op sequence.
steps: Pick three close shops with your partner.
Rob them back-to-back while keeping your Wanted Level.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles, tracked by PSN to 100. Discovery happens by encountering vehicles, so the count grows across normal play and exploration; a final sweep of rare vehicle spots closes the gap. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the 100 target.
steps: Drive and encounter new vehicles.
Track discoveries toward 100.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Set it up where enemies group together, trigger Combat Focus, and chain five takedowns before it ends; a failed attempt costs nothing but the setup. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement; the best spot is not yet confirmed in-game.
steps: Find a spot where enemies group up.
Trigger Combat Focus and take down 5 enemies in that one use.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the airport. This is a watch item: the description names a one-off departure that is not a scheduled flight, so try it deliberately at the airport rather than waiting for it to happen. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement; the exact departure is not yet confirmed in-game.
trophies.missableBasis: From the official description: make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — a one-off moment at the airport.
steps: Go to VCIA.
Make an unscheduled departure.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with Rhinos, the tanks, as the description hints. This is a watch item because the description points at a specific tank encounter rather than a repeatable activity; take the encounter when it comes and do not assume it will come again. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement; the exact encounter is not yet confirmed in-game.
trophies.missableBasis: From the official description: 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' — a specific tank encounter.
steps: Find a Rhino tank encounter.
Complete what the encounter asks.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Stealth is the whole trophy: plan the entry, avoid cameras and staff sightlines, and leave before the alarm; if you are spotted, the attempt fails and you try again. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement.
steps: Pick a jewelry store and plan a quiet entry.
Rob it without being detected.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape, tracked by PSN to 5. Each vault is a robbery plus a clean escape, so the count only grows when both halves succeed; plan the getaway before the robbery, not after it. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the 5 target.
steps: Rob a bank vault.
Escape cleanly, then repeat until you reach 5.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks appear on the roads, so watch for one, stop it, take the cash and get clear before the response arrives. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement.
steps: Find an armored truck on the road.
Rob it and escape.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida, tracked by PSN to 52. The map fills in as you travel, so this pairs naturally with the meditation spots and the WAiNK locations; finish it by visiting the areas your travels never took you to. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the 52 target.
steps: Travel across Leonida and visit new areas.
Check the counter and visit the remaining areas.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs, tracked by PSN to 9. One operation per gang is enough, so the work is finding an operation for each gang and clearing it; a gang with no operation robbed yet is the next target. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the 9 target.
steps: Find an illegal operation of a gang you have not robbed.
Rob one operation per gang until you reach 9.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. This is a watch item: the description names a specific place and a specific quiet moment, so do it deliberately at Ocean Beach rather than assuming any drink anywhere counts. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement.
trophies.missableBasis: From the official description: enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — a specific place-and-moment scene.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach.
Enjoy a cocktail with the view.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Take a vehicle and drive it straight out through the showroom front; the trophy is about the exit, so commit to it once you are inside. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement; the exact showroom is not yet confirmed in-game.
steps: Enter a vehicle showroom in a vehicle.
Smash your way out through the front.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Bowling is a simple activity trophy: visit the named alley and bowl a game through to its end. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Bowl a game to its end.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach a partnership moment with mass appeal, as the vague official description puts it. The description names no place, count or action, so this guide cannot pin down steps honestly; watch for a partnership scene that draws a crowd and treat it as the likely trigger. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the description; the trigger is not yet confirmed in-game.
steps: Play through partnership story beats.
Watch for a public partnership moment.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices, tracked by PSN to 500. This is a watch item because choices are made once and cannot be unmade: the description itself is the warning, so make choices deliberately across the game and keep playing rather than reloading to undo them. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the 500 target.
trophies.missableBasis: From the official description: 'Choices made (for better or worse)' — choices are made once and cannot be unmade.
steps: Make choices as they appear in missions and the open world.
Keep a steady pace; the counter grows across the whole game.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try, as the description hints. This is a watch item because it points at a specific second attempt; if an attempt fails once, try it again right away instead of moving on, since the retry may be the trigger. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the description; the exact moment is not yet confirmed in-game.
trophies.missableBasis: From the official description: 'Second time's the charm' — a second attempt at a specific moment.
steps: Attempt a challenge that can fail.
Succeed on the second try.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange, as the description suggests. This is a watch item because it points at a one-off strange event rather than a repeatable task; explore odd corners of Leonida and pay attention when something out of the ordinary happens. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the description; the event is not yet confirmed in-game.
trophies.missableBasis: From the official description: 'What the hell just happened?' — a one-off strange event.
steps: Explore unusual places in Leonida.
Trigger and witness the strange event.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by at the bowling alley. This is a watch item: the description combines bowling with a melee drive-by, a very specific action in a specific place, so set it up at the alley on purpose. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement; the exact setup is not yet confirmed in-game.
trophies.missableBasis: From the official description: 'Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by' — a specific bowling-alley action.
steps: Go to the bowling alley.
Perform a melee drive-by there.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts, tracked by PSN to 250,000. Marked Bills come from robberies, so this counter grows as you rob and launder; keep laundering steadily instead of stockpiling bills. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the 250,000 target.
steps: Collect Marked Bills from robberies.
Launder them through your contacts until you reach $250,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops, tracked by PSN to 100,000. Every shop purchase counts, so this fills in across normal play; late in the game, buy the useful big-ticket items you still want rather than wasting money. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the 100,000 target.
steps: Buy gear, clothes and vehicles in shops.
Track spending toward $100,000.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties, tracked by PSN to 8. Garages are bought with in-game money, so save for them across the game and buy each one as it becomes available; the last garage is the finish line. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the 8 target.
steps: Save in-game money for garages.
Purchase all 8 garage properties.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, tracked by PSN to 10. Registration is a quick action per vehicle, so register each new vehicle you keep instead of letting them pile up unregistered. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the 10 target.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app with a vehicle.
Register 10 vehicles.
